subject: Quick technical sync before product demo — FreshDistro

From: Alex Torres <alex.t@freshdistro.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 15:11:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 15-min technical screen before demo

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after our self-serve signup. Before we jump into a full product demo, our engineering lead wants a short 15-minute technical screen just to confirm compatibility and make sure the demo focuses on the right integrations. Can we schedule a quick slot this week or early next?

A few context items:
- We run services on AWS (us-west-2), mostly ECS + RDS; some pre-prod data is in S3.
- Data residency requirement: US only.
- Our security reviewer will want to confirm logging/audit capabilities and whether requests persist on your hosted API.

Suggested availability (Pacific): Thu 9/9 10:00–11:00, Thu 9/9 15:00–16:00, Fri 9/10 09:00–12:00. If none of those work we can do early next week.

If helpful, our engineer Sam will join: Sam Lee <sam.lee@freshdistro.com>.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Platform
FreshDistro

- No VPC peering or on-prem connectors in our current PoC setup — all traffic is egress to public endpoints via corporate NAT.
- We do use an outbound proxy (company wide) but we can open an exception for the short call if you need to reach specific endpoints during the demo.
- We will review your pre-demo checklist tonight and flag anything important.

Please send the calendar invite and any docs we should review ahead of the call. Looking forward to it.
